'''Xesh Squad''' was a unit in the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces Division]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The squad succeeded in bombing the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] itself during the Cold War, and when [[Galactic War]] broke out with the Empire around [[3641 BBY]], Xesh Squad was assigned to infiltrate an Imperial base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. However, they were killed after their successful infiltration when Imperial forces tracked them to an abandoned [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] outpost on the [[Clabburn Tundra]].
